original.statement: ExpireAfter has moved from NodePool.Spec.Disruption to NodePool.Spec.Template.Spec and is now a drift-able field.

decision.reason: [ev-1253ff5bd0a5] says ExpireAfter "has moved from the `NodePool.Spec.Disruption` block to `NodePool.Spec.Template.Spec`". So the subject is karpenter.sh NodePool spec.disruption.expireAfter, and the change is a rename with replacedBy spec.template.spec.expireAfter. The CRD validator found the old path in the NodePool schema of both releases [ev-09bbe26d2f4a][ev-760ae3491f13]. It also found that the move goes from v1beta1 to v1. The upgrade-guide text itself never names an API version, so under the identity rules the subject and replacedBy correctly leave out version. The "now drift-able" part changes behaviour, not the subject or the change type here.
